text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Control record for the one-episode sit task.
+
+Run `python /app/output/gen.py observe` for a free observation, or use
+`pose`/`hold` to send position-servo targets. Every motion call is appended
+to actions.jsonl, which `replay` can submit in order for a fresh episode.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+LOG = OUT / "actions.jsonl"
+
+
+def angle_to_action(q, ranges):
+    r = np.asarray(ranges, dtype=float)
+    return np.clip(2 * (np.asarray(q) - r[:, 0]) / (r[:, 1] - r[:, 0]) - 1, -1, 1)
+
+
+def save_result(res, label):
+    step = res.meta["control_steps"]
+    for name, frame in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"{step:04d}_{label}_{name}.png")
+    record = {k: res.meta.get(k) for k in ("control_steps", "done", "reason", "clipped", "proprio")}
+    print(json.dumps(record))
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument("command", choices=["observe", "pose", "hold", "replay", "status"])
+    p.add_argument("--angles", help="19 joint angles in radians as JSON list")
+    p.add_argument("--actions", help="19 normalized servo targets as JSON list")
+    p.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=10)
+    p.add_argument("--camera", default="room_camera")
+    args = p.parse_args()
+    r = Robot()
+    if args.command == "status":
+        print(json.dumps(r.status()))
+        return
+    if args.command == "observe":
+        save_result(r.get_obs(cameras=[args.camera, "left_eye_camera"], video="none"), "obs")
+        return
+    if args.command == "replay":
+        for line in LOG.read_text().splitlines():
+            item = json.loads(line)
+            res = r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(item["actions"]), dt=0.02,
+                           cameras=[args.camera], video="none")
+            save_result(res, "replay")
+            if res.done:
+                break
+        return
+    if args.command == "hold":
+        last = json.loads(LOG.read_text().splitlines()[-1])
+        target = np.asarray(last["actions"][-1])
+    elif args.angles:
+        target = angle_to_action(json.loads(args.angles), r.spec()["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"])
+    else:
+        target = np.asarray(json.loads(args.actions), dtype=float)
+    if args.command == "pose":
+        obs = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
+        q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:19])
+        start = angle_to_action(q, r.spec()["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"])
+        actions = np.linspace(start, target, args.steps)
+    else:
+        actions = np.repeat(target[None], args.steps, axis=0)
+    with LOG.open("a") as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps({"actions": actions.tolist()}) + "\n")
+    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.02, cameras=[args.camera, "left_eye_camera"], video="none")
+    save_result(res, args.command)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"))
